page.notes: The calculation display is set as a centred block of numbers with dot marks and lines; transcribed line by line as lines of the display. Some digits in the display are uncertain (e.g. the superscript-like dots and the factor 7 in "+63 87" row). The right-edge strip is the facing page's text, cut off; only partial words are visible and were not transcribed as text. The catchword "Inuen-" is at the foot and was included as the last line of text.
